scope: Node worker-thread memory model of decoder numeric transfer; not a browser acceptance run
verified: Both modes compare every restored value with Object.is, including signed zero.
model: A worker retains four ordinary numeric arrays and matching Float64 buffers. Baseline transfers all buffers, waits for worker exit, then rebuilds arrays. Streaming transfers one buffer at a time and rebuilds it while the worker retains its arrays.
limitations: Node worker threads and synthetic arrays are not Chromium workers, real project decoding, rendering or public MCP.
The model does not hold an old project, exercise validation, aliases, cancellation or compressed input.
Streaming with earlier ownership release or a different representation was not tested.
Separate sequential runs do not establish the allocation source of the real browser peak.
